description: This PHP class 'JsonRpcSerializer' prepares and serializes JSON-RPC requests for AWS SDK commands, including handling endpoint resolution and request construction.

classes.name: JsonRpcSerializer
classes.description: A serializer class that prepares JSON-RPC requests for AWS SDK commands, handling request creation, endpoint setup, and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the serializer with service description, endpoint, and optional JSON formatter.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Serializes an AWS command into a JSON-RPC request, setting headers, endpoint, and body accordingly.
